prediction_anchor.calibration_note: Temperature scaling did not generalise (T~0); the probability figures are a RELATIVE RANKING CN<MCI<AD, not absolute confidence percentages.
prediction_anchor.validated_domain_note: OASIS-3 structural MRI processed with FreeSurfer. Scans from other sites or pipelines (for example ADNI processed with FastSurfer) are outside the validated range and should be flagged by the out-of-domain check.

spatial_xai_anchor.structure_saliency_caveat: Saliency concentration does not by itself confirm the disease-specific atrophy pattern reported in the literature; ventricular dominance and non-monotonic staging across CN/MCI/AD have been observed independently of diagnostic accuracy.

clinical_covariates.covariate_caveat: Covariates are read-only (used_in_primary_decision=false). APOE genotype is encoded as a single e4-presence flag, without accounting for the protective e2 allele, and must never be presented as evidence for or against Alzheimer's disease — regardless of which alleles are present.
